items.title: Rooftop Embers & Basalt Hearth
items.desc: An open-air culinary experience where native wood and dry charcoal flame-grill seasonal harvest under Gachibowli's night skies. Savor dishes served on raw basalt slate.

items.title: Live Sports, Big Screens
items.desc: Catch every match on our massive screens while enjoying wood-fired wings, craft beers, and handcrafted cocktails. The best game day experience in Gachibowli.

items.title: Private Dining & Celebrations
items.desc: Host your next event in our elegant private dining spaces. Whether it's a birthday, corporate dinner, or anniversary, we craft a bespoke menu and atmosphere just for you.
